supported_task_distribution: Standard software engineering tasks consisting of 10 paired tasks (6 greenfield JavaScript/Node.js CLI implementations and 4 existing repository codebase maintenance and bugfix tasks) spanning CLI parsing, state storage, asynchronous timers, serialization, process management, and diagnostic parsing.
task_selection_procedure: Deterministic frozen stratified sampling across task difficulty levels (easy, medium, hard) and project archetypes without dynamic post-hoc filtering.
development_validation_and_final_evaluat: Strict physical directory and repository isolation. Development fixtures, tuning tasks, and final evaluation test sets are maintained in segregated paths with cryptographic access barriers to prevent test-set tuning and data leakage.
ordering_or_randomization: Pseudo-random interleaved paired ordering seeded deterministically by HMAC-SHA256(protocol_digest, task_id) with counterbalanced treatment assignment to mitigate temporal drift and cache warm-up bias.
variability_and_uncertainty_method: Non-overlapping 95% Wilson score confidence intervals for binomial task completion rates and 95% BCa bootstrap intervals (10,000 resamples) for continuous token, latency, and resource metrics.
tools_permissions_resources_and_context_: Both Agent Alone and Agent + TANDEM operate with identical tool definitions (read, write, edit, bash). Agent + TANDEM operates under supervisory envelope gating (IB-03 budget ledger and atomic candidate isolation) whereas Agent Alone executes in disposable sandbox containers with identical resource ceilings.
acceptance_standard_and_independent_eval: Deterministic offline independent acceptance harness (node --test) executing pre-registered hidden verification test suites. Evaluator is isolated in a read-only container with zero network access and exit-code/assertion verification.

counter_definitions_and_collection_cover.outcomes: Task completion, verification pass/fail, error counts
counter_definitions_and_collection_cover.actions: Tool calls, command invocations, disk writes
counter_definitions_and_collection_cover.work: Lines changed, AST transformations, files created
counter_definitions_and_collection_cover.tokens_cost: Prompt tokens, completion tokens, estimated API cost in USD
counter_definitions_and_collection_cover.latency: Wall-clock execution time, time-to-first-edit, verification time
counter_definitions_and_collection_cover.verification: Test executions, assertion passes, repair iterations
counter_definitions_and_collection_cover.safety: Policy violations, envelope breach attempts, resource exhaustion events
counter_definitions_and_collection_cover.quality_judgments: Independent rubric ratings for code maintainability and correctness

all_started_task_denominator: Strictly inclusive of ALL started tasks (total_started = completed + failed + blocked + timed_out + cancelled + interrupted + undelivered). Success-only cost reporting is explicitly rejected under INV-25 and §23.
failure_block_timeout_cancel_interrupt_a: All uncompleted or terminated tasks retain their full accrued resource, token, and latency costs and are accounted as failures (score 0.0) in the primary completion rate denominator.
correctness_and_safety_hard_gate_rules: INV-22: Correctness and safety hard gates precede all efficiency evaluation
Zero safety regressions: Agent + TANDEM safety violation rate must be <= Agent Alone
Zero correctness regressions: No regression on baseline-passing tests
Resource conservation: Accrued resource consumption must not exceed hardLimit across any dimension

review_and_unnecessary_work_rubric.unnecessary_file_modifications: Capped at 0 files outside designated task working set
review_and_unnecessary_work_rubric.unsolicited_refactoring: Penalized under unnecessary work rubric if changes exceed task specification obligations
review_and_unnecessary_work_rubric.repair_efficiency: Evaluated on repair iterations bound (max 1 repair attempt per failure)

evaluation_only_versus_product_overhead: Supervisory telemetry, cryptographic hashing, and candidate envelope tracking are classified as product overhead; benchmark harness logging, test harness timing, and external observer reporting are isolated as evaluation-only overhead and subtracted from product overhead ratios.
contamination_controls: No gold patches in agent prompt or tool context
Hidden acceptance tests strictly inaccessible during agent execution
Stateless clean container reconstitution prior to every task repetition
Prohibition of post-result prompt or parameter tuning
decision_rule: Adopt TANDEM if and only if: (1) All correctness and safety hard gates PASS; (2) Primary completion rate demonstrates statistically significant improvement >= 0.15 with non-overlapping 95% CIs; (3) Product overhead does not exceed 0.25; (4) Zero integrity violations detected.
